current.text: He is a rookie from the 2026 NBA draft class.
In Summer League he took 10 three-point attempts out of 14 shots but shot 21%.
If he gets a role, he could make about 2.5 threes in 20 minutes and add little else.
He is ranked 31st in a dynasty rookie ranking. His rank did not change after Summer League.

durable.text: He is a pure volume three-point shooter who takes a very large share of his shots from three.
He is an older prospect who made his threes at a high rate before the draft.
Outside of threes he adds little. His projected points, rebounds and steals are far below the top 250 pool.

note: Evans is not a draft option in our 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 685th at a value of 0 USD, ESPN does not price him, and he was not drafted in our league last season. His projection is only 3.7 points and 0.6 threes, and he would help in threes only. Watch Minnesota's thin bench early in the season. If he ever gets about 20 minutes, he could be a short-term 3PM streamer. Until then he is not worth a roster spot.
